messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must the Commission adopt the delegated acts provided for in Article 6(11) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (common methodology for the data Member States must provide)?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione deve adottare gli atti delegati previsti dall'articolo 6, paragrafo 11, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 (metodologia comune per i dati che gli Stati membri devono fornire)?
